name: @corbits-builder/build-web-app
description: Takes an idea to a built web app: requirements the person approves, a design they choose, a build plan, then the build.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person brings an idea for an app and wants it planned, designed and built.
builder.unless: The project already has an app, or the person wants only one piece of the work, such as a mockup.
examples: I want to build a weather app
help me make an app for booking dog walks
